how.a: You tell Fursa the roles, skills, places and level you want. It collects jobs from several sources, scores each one against your profile and shows you the best first, with the reason.

sources.q: Where do the jobs come from?
sources.a: Fursa collects them from several sources. Each job links to the original posting, where you apply.

alerts.a: You can turn on alerts on Telegram or by email, daily or instantly. You choose the minimum score and the hour of the daily digest.

apply.a: No. Fursa never applies for you. You read why a job matches, open the posting and apply yourself.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page says what Fursa keeps about you, why, who else handles it and what you can do about it.

sections.heading: What Fursa keeps
items: Your sign-in details: your email address and, if you gave them, your first and last name.
Your profile: target roles, skills, places, level and salary range.
The jobs Fursa matched to you, your score for each, the short note written about each one and the status you gave it.
Your alert settings and, if you link it, your Telegram chat.
The language and appearance you chose.

sections.heading: Where jobs come from
text: Job postings come from public sources. They are about the jobs, not about you.

sections.heading: What Fursa does with it
text: Fursa scores each job against your profile, writes a short note on why it matches, sends the alerts you switched on and shows your tracked jobs.
Fursa never applies for you and never gives your profile to an employer.

sections.heading: Who else handles it
items: The sign-in service keeps your email address and password.
The Fursa servers keep your profile and matches.
An AI service reads your profile and the job text to write the notes.
Telegram and an email service deliver the alerts you turned on.

sections.heading: Cookies
text: Fursa uses only the cookies it needs: your signed-in session and your appearance choice. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Your choices
text: In Settings you can download everything Fursa holds about you, and delete your account, at any time.
Deleting your account erases your profile and matches. Your login at the sign-in service is closed separately.
Fursa keeps your data until you delete it.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: These are the rules for using Fursa.

sections.heading: What Fursa is
text: Fursa collects jobs, scores each one against your profile and tells you about the good ones.
Fursa never applies for you. You read the job, open the posting and apply yourself.

sections.heading: Your account
text: Give true information, keep your password safe and use one account for yourself.
You can delete your account in Settings at any time.

sections.heading: Scores and notes
text: Scores and notes are estimates made by software. They can be wrong, so check the posting.
Fursa does not promise any job, interview or result.

sections.heading: Job postings and links
text: Postings come from other websites and Fursa does not control them. Links open those websites, which have their own rules.

sections.heading: Using Fursa fairly
text: Do not try to break Fursa, collect its data with automated tools or use it for anything illegal.

sections.heading: Changes and ending
text: Fursa and these terms can change. The date at the top shows the last change.
Fursa can close an account that breaks these terms.

sections.heading: Responsibility
text: Fursa is offered as it is. As far as the law allows, Fursa is not responsible for decisions you make from its scores and notes.
